entries.title: Nahum 1 — Chapter Introduction
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: the statutes of Omri are kept. or, he doth much keep the,etc. 1Ki 16:25-30; Ho 5:11 the works. 1Ki 16:30-33; 18:4; 21:25,26; 2Ki 16:3; 21:3; Isa 9:16; Re 2:20 ye walk. Ps 1:1; Jer 7:24 that. 1Ki 9:8; 2Ch 29:8,9; 34:25; Jer 18:15,16; 19:8; 21:8,9; Eze 8:17,18 desolation. or, astonishment. therefore. Ps 44:13; Isa 25:8; Jer 51:51; La 5:1; Eze 39:26; Da 9:16

entries.title: Nahum 1:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 The majesty of God in goodness to his people, and severity against his enemies.

burden. Isa 13:1; 14:28; 15:1; 21:1; 22:1; 23:1; Jer 23:33-37; Zec 9:1 Nineveh. Ge 10:11; Jon 3:3,4; Zep 2:13

entries.title: Nahum 1:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: God is jealous, and the Lord revengeth. or, The Lord is ajealous God, and a revenger. Ex 20:5; 34:14; De 4:24; Jos 24:19; Isa 42:13; Eze 38:18; 39:25 Joe 2:18; Zec 1:14; 8:2 revengeth. De 32:35,42; Ps 94:1; Isa 59:17,18; Ro 12:19; 13:4; Heb 10:30 is furious. Heb. that hath fury. Le 26:28; Job 20:23; Isa 51:17,20; 59:18; 63:3-6; 66:15 Jer 4:4; 25:15; 36:7; La 4:11; Eze 5:13; 6:12; 8:18; 36:6; Mic 5:15 Zec 8:2 reserveth. De 32:34,35,41-43; Jer 3:5; Mic 7:18; Ro 2:5,6; 2Pe 2:9

entries.title: Nahum 1:12
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Through, etc. or, If they would have been at peace, so shouldthey have been many, and so should they have been shorn, and he should have passed away. yet. 2Ki 19:35,37; Isa 10:32-34; 14:24-27; 17:14; 30:28-33; 31:8; 37:36 cut down. Heb. shorn. Isa 7:20 pass. 15; Ex 12:12; Isa 8:8; Da 11:10 I will. Isa 30:19; 51:22; 60:18-20; Joe 2:19; Re 7:16
